title: 第39章 这具身体还是太弱了
novel_title: 财神爷加好友！我被神仙团宠暴富(舒起起)
content_zh: 所有下车的警察，看到的就是眼前这一幕——一个穿着睡衣、踩着拖鞋的女孩，正握着钢管，对着最后两个黑衣人。那两个人已经被打得毫无还手之力，手里的钢管胡乱挥舞，脚下踉踉跄跄。女孩侧身一让，躲开一棍，反手一挑，一根钢管脱手飞出！紧接着，她往前一步，一棍扫在另一个人的膝盖窝，那人“噗通”一声跪在地上。最后一个黑衣人想跑。女孩抬手，钢管脱手飞出，在空中转了两圈，“啪”地一声砸在他后背上。那人扑倒在地。她走过去，弯腰捡起钢管，顺手在那人后脑勺上轻轻敲了一下。“老实点。”温栩栩直起身，把钢管在手里转了个圈，缓缓收势。身上睡衣无褶皱，衣角微脏。警察们举着枪，却不知道该瞄准谁。地上躺了一片，唯一站着的是个穿睡衣的小姑娘——这枪往哪儿指？有人小声嘀咕：“卧槽，这身手……武术冠军退役的？”旁边的人咽了口唾沫：“武术冠军也没这么猛吧，一挑八还穿拖鞋……”领队的队长张了张嘴，半天憋出一句：“是谁报的警？”温栩栩把钢管往地上一顿，晚风吹起她的黑发：“警察叔叔，是我！！”为首的警队队长低头看了一眼地上躺了的一片黑衣人，又抬头看了一眼眼前这个小姑娘。警队队长默默收起枪，对着对讲机说了一句：“叫救护车。再多叫几辆。”对讲机那头立刻紧张起来：“队长！人质伤得很重吗？！需要几辆？！”队长低头看了一眼被温栩栩护在身后、除了衣服有点脏外毫发无损的小男孩，又扫了一圈地上横七竖八、哀嚎连连的黑衣人。他沉默了两秒。“人质没事。”他说，“绑匪伤得很重。”对讲机那头傻眼了。警方简单给温栩栩做了个笔录。说是笔录，其实就是走个流程，人证物证都在，监控也调出来了，温栩栩属于正当防卫。笔录做完，放监控的电脑屏幕还亮着。几个警察围在屏幕前，把刚才那段录像来来回回看了不下十遍。第一遍，确认温栩栩是怎么在几秒之内就把孩子抢回来的。第二遍，确认她是用拖鞋把人抽懵的。第三遍，确认她确实是穿着睡衣一挑八。第四遍、第五遍、第六遍……已经开始回味温栩栩的身手棍法。“我靠，这一棍扫得也太帅了。”“你看这个转身，这个收棍，这个步伐——绝了！”“这用棍的手法，我怎么看着有点眼熟？”一个年轻警察挠了挠头，忽然一拍大腿：“齐天大圣！这不是跟齐天大圣耍棍子的感觉一样吗？！”旁边几人纷纷点头：“对对对！我说怎么这么帅！”“那股劲儿，就是大圣内味儿！”温栩栩低着头，嘴角抽了抽。脑海里，大圣的声音炸开了：“什么？！他们怎么看出来的？！”那语气又惊又喜，还带着点“俺老孙果然藏不住”的得意。温栩栩默默在心里回他：【因为您是国民男神啊，大圣。】大圣安静了一秒。然后温栩栩感觉自已的脑子里传来一阵嘚瑟的哼哼声，那尾巴，都快翘到天上去了。正说着，一个看肩章警衔就很牛的的中年警察走了过来，表情严肃，气势很足。温栩栩以为要问什么要紧事。结果那大叔往她面前一站，开口就是：“小姑娘，体校毕业的？还是武校？”温栩栩摇头：“不是，我是学服装设计的。”大叔愣了一下，然后眼神更亮了：“我去，这文武双全啊！”温栩栩：“……”大叔清了清嗓子，正色道：“刚才的事，我们看了监控，你属于正当防卫，还是见义勇为。”“局里会给你申请‘见义勇为市民奖’，回头会有通知。”温栩栩点点头：“谢谢警察叔叔。”大叔顿了顿，压低声音：“那个……兼职教官的事，你再考虑考虑？待遇好商量。”温栩栩笑着摆摆手：“谢谢警察叔叔，我还是更适合拿针线。”说完，她蹲下来，跟那个被救的小男孩挥了挥手。小男孩眼睛亮晶晶的，奶声奶气地喊了一句：“姐姐你是女侠吗？”温栩栩愣了一下，伸手揉了揉他的脑袋：“不是，姐姐是齐天大圣的传人。”然后打了个哈欠，转身往夜色里走。走出十几米，温栩栩感觉自已的腿开始发软，胳膊也开始酸，整个人像被抽干了力气。刚才打架的时候不觉得，现在劲儿一过，浑身哪儿都疼。大圣的声音在脑海里响起，带着几分嫌弃：“这具身体，还是太弱了。”温栩栩有气无力回复：“大圣，我是凡人。”大圣沉默了两秒，悠悠地补了一句：“那得练。改天俺老孙教你套棍法，顺便给你淬淬体。”温栩栩脚步一顿。淬……淬体？她低头看了一眼自已那双还在发颤的腿。忽然觉得，明天开始可能要过上“大圣特训”的日子了。温栩栩回到家，连睡衣都没换，一头栽进床里。睡着了。梦里她还在飞檐走壁，一棍扫倒八个黑衣人。帅得不行。然后——脑海里传来大圣精力充沛的声音：“丫头，醒醒。”温栩栩迷迷糊糊睁开眼，天已经亮了。她翻了个身，准备继续睡。“醒醒，帮俺老孙点吃的。”温栩栩：“……什么？”手机被塞到她手里。大圣的声音在脑海里响起，带着一种“俺老孙已经研究明白了”的得意：“你们凡人那个外卖软件，俺老孙看了一早上，学会了。”温栩栩揉着眼睛坐起来，低头一看屏幕——整个人愣住了。手机屏幕上，某团外卖的购物车里静静躺着：白桃乌龙奶茶×2桃桃奶盖×2桃桃果茶×2白桃慕斯蛋糕×1蜜桃千层×1白桃味大福×1桃子布丁×1还有一整个水蜜桃拼盘。温栩栩盯着那长长的订单列表，沉默了足足五秒。“……大圣。”“嗯？”“您点这么多……喝得完吗？”“俺老孙就想尝尝。”大圣的语气里带着点理直气壮，“你们凡人说的‘桃子味’，和真桃子有啥不一样。”温栩栩握着手机，看着购物车里那一堆粉粉嫩嫩的含桃量极高的吃喝饮品，嘴角忍不住抽。齐天大圣。花果山美猴王。当年大闹天宫，一根金箍棒打得十万天兵天将抱头鼠窜。此刻，正住在她脑子里，等着喝白桃乌龙。温栩栩没忍住，笑出了声。“大圣，您知道您这样反差萌么！”“萌？”大圣语气一扬，“俺老孙那是威武！”温栩栩点下“提交订单”，默默在心里补了一句：威武的齐天大圣，爱喝白桃乌龙奶茶。这画面，太美。温栩栩把订单提交上去，特意选了“加急配送”。不到二十分钟，手机响了。“您好，这里是物业管家外卖已到门口，请您签收。”大圣一听，兴奋得差点又翻窗户。温栩栩感觉自已的腿已经往窗边迈了——“大圣！！！”她一把拽住窗框，在心里疯狂呐喊，“走楼梯！楼梯！我是正常人！！！”大圣这才不情不愿地收回腿，操控着她的身体慢悠悠往楼下走。温栩栩松了口气。打开门的瞬间，她愣住了。门口站着的，不光是穿着制服、提着外卖袋子的小区管家。
content_en: All the police officers who got out of the car saw this scene - a girl wearing pajamas and slippers, holding a steel pipe and facing the last two men in black.The two men had been beaten to the point where they were unable to fight back. They were waving the steel pipes in their hands randomly and stumbling on their feet.The girl stepped aside, dodged a stick, and with a backhand move, a steel pipe flew out of her hand!Then, she took a step forward and swiped the stick at the other person's knee. The person knelt on the ground with a "pop".The last man in black wanted to run away.The girl raised her hand, and the steel pipe flew out, spun twice in the air, and hit his back with a "snap".The man fell to the ground.She walked over, bent down to pick up the steel pipe, and tapped the man on the back of his head."Be honest." Wen Xuxu straightened up, turned the steel pipe in a circle in his hand, and slowly stopped.The pajamas on her body were wrinkle-free and slightly dirty at the corners.The policemen raised their guns but didn't know who to aim at.There was a piece of ground lying on the ground, and the only one standing was a little girl in pajamas - where was this gun pointed?Someone muttered in a low voice: "Damn, this skill... a retired martial arts champion?" The person next to him swallowed: "The martial arts champion is not that strong, right? He is one to eight and still wears slippers..." The leader of the team opened his mouth and held back for a long time: "Yes.Who called the police?" Wen Xuxu slammed the steel pipe to the ground, and the evening wind blew her black hair: "Uncle police, it's me!" The leader of the police team looked down at the men in black lying on the ground, and then looked up at the little girl in front of him.The police captain silently put away his gun and said into the walkie-talkie: "Call an ambulance. Call a few more." The other end of the walkie-talkie immediately became nervous: "Captain! Are the hostages seriously injured?! How many vehicles are needed?!" The captain looked down at the little boy who was protected by Wen Xuxu behind him and was unharmed except for his clothes being a little dirty, and then glanced around at the men in black who were scattered on the ground and wailing.He was silent for two seconds."The hostages are fine," he said, "the kidnappers are seriously injured." The other end of the intercom was dumbfounded.The police made a brief note for Wen Xuxu.It's said to be a record, but in fact it's just a process. The witnesses and physical evidence are all there, and the surveillance is also brought out. Wen Xuxu is acting in legitimate defense.After the transcript was finished, the monitor computer screen was still on.Several police officers gathered around the screen and watched the video over and over again no less than ten times.The first time, confirming how Wen Xuxu snatched the child back within seconds.The second time, it was confirmed that she used her slippers to knock people out.The third time confirmed that she was indeed wearing pajamas.The fourth time, the fifth time, the sixth time... I have begun to reminisce about Wen Xuxu's stick skills."Damn, this stick sweep is so cool." "Look at this turn, this withdrawal of the stick, this pace - amazing!" "Why does this stick technique look familiar to me?" A young policeman scratched his head and suddenly slapped his thigh: "Monkey King!Isn't this the same as Monkey King playing with a stick?" Several people nearby nodded: "Yes, yes!Why is it so handsome?" Wen Xuxu lowered his head and twitched his mouth.In his mind, the Great Sage's voice exploded: "What?! How did they see it?!" The tone was surprised and happy, with a bit of pride that "I really can't hide it".Wen Xuxu replied to him silently in her heart: "Because you are the national male god, the great sage."】The Great Sage was quiet for a second.Then Wen Xuxu felt a humming sound coming from her head, and her tail almost reached the sky.Just as he was talking, a middle-aged policeman who looked very impressive based on his shoulder badges and police rank came over, with a serious expression and full of momentum.Wen Xuxu thought he wanted to ask about something important.As a result, the uncle stood in front of her and said: "Little girl, you graduated from a sports school? Or a martial arts school?" Wen Xuxu shook his head: "No, I study fashion design." The uncle was stunned for a moment, and then his eyes brightened: "I'll go, this man is both civil and military!" Wen Xuxu: "..." The uncle cleared his throat and said seriously: "What happened just now, we checked the surveillance, you were in legitimate defense, or you were acting bravely."The bureau will apply for the 'Citizen Award for Volunteering' and you will be notified later."Wen Xuxu nodded: "Thank you, uncle policeman."The uncle paused and lowered his voice: "That... part-time instructor, you can think about it again? The salary is negotiable."Wen Xuxu smiled and waved: "Thank you, uncle policeman."After that, she squatted down and waved to the little boy who was rescued.The little boy's eyes were bright and he shouted in a sweet voice: "Sister, are you a heroine?" Wen Xuxu was stunned for a moment, then reached out and rubbed his head: "No, sister is the descendant of the Monkey King." Then he yawned and turned around and walked into the night.After walking more than ten meters, Wen Xuxu felt that her legs began to weaken, her arms began to ache, and her whole body seemed to have been drained of strength.I didn't feel it during the fight just now, but now that the energy has passed, I feel pain everywhere.The Great Sage's voice sounded in his mind, with a hint of disgust: "This body is still too weak." Wen Xuxu replied feebly: "Great Sage, I am a mortal." The Great Sage was silent for two seconds, and then added leisurely: "That requires practice. Another day, I will teach you how to set the stick, and temper your body by the way." Wen Xuxu paused.Tempering... body quenching?She looked down at her trembling legs.Suddenly I felt that starting tomorrow I might have to live a life of "special training from the great sage".When Wen Xuxu returned home, she didn't even change into her pajamas and fell into bed.Fell asleep.In the dream, she was still flying over the walls, mowing down eight men in black with one stick.Extremely handsome.Then - the energetic voice of the Great Sage came from his mind: "Girl, wake up." Wen Xuxu opened her eyes in a daze, and it was already dawn.She turned over and prepared to go back to sleep."Wake up, help my grandson order something to eat." Wen Xuxu: "...what?" The phone was thrust into her hand.The Great Sage's voice sounded in his mind, with a sense of pride that "I have studied and understood it": "I, the mortal, have learned the takeout software after studying it all morning." Wen Xuxu rubbed his eyes and sat up, lowered his head and looked at the screen - he was stunned.On the screen of the mobile phone, the shopping cart of a certain group of takeaways lay quietly: White Peach Oolong Milk Tea × 2 Peach Milk Caps × 2 Peach Fruit Tea × 2 White Peach Mousse Cake × 1 Peach Mille Crepe × 1 White Peach Flavored Daifuku × 1 Peach Pudding × 1 and a whole peach platter.Wen Xuxu stared at the long order list and was silent for five seconds."...The Great Sage." "Huh?" "You ordered so much...can you finish it?" "I just want to try it." The Great Sage's tone was a little confident, "What's the difference between the 'peach flavor' you mortals call and real peaches." Wen Xuxu held her cell phone and looked at the pile of pink and tender drinks with a high peach content in the shopping cart, and couldn't help but twitch the corner of her mouth.Monkey King.The Monkey King of Huaguo Mountain.There was a big commotion in the Heavenly Palace, and a golden cudgel beat a hundred thousand heavenly soldiers and generals to flee with their heads in their arms.At this moment, it was living in her mind, waiting to drink the white peach oolong.Wen Xuxu couldn't hold back and laughed out loud."Great Sage, do you know how cute you are!" "Cute?" The Great Sage said in a high tone, "My grandson is so mighty!" Wen Xuxu clicked "Submit Order" and silently added in her heart: The mighty Monkey King, loves to drink white peach oolong milk tea.This picture is so beautiful.Wen Xuxu submitted the order and specifically chose "expedited delivery".Less than twenty minutes later, the phone rang."Hello, the takeaway from the property manager has arrived at the door. Please sign for it." Upon hearing this, the great sage was so excited that he almost opened the window again.Wen Xuxu felt that her legs had already moved towards the window - "Great Sage!!!" She grabbed the window frame and shouted crazily in her heart, "Take the stairs! Stairs! I am a normal person!!!" The Great Sage reluctantly retracted her legs and controlled her body to walk slowly downstairs.Wen Xuxu breathed a sigh of relief.The moment she opened the door, she was stunned.Standing at the door were not just community housekeepers in uniforms and carrying takeout bags.
